checks.name: S6 runtime is self-contained without ROM, upstream caches, fonts or answers
Source and implementation identities are recorded; frozen answers never enter the resource build
Typed full lexical names, raw unknown names and no partial names obey the saved name policy
Species, elemental types, status and word-picker types cannot force a global homograph winner
All 354 native move forms have reviewed full-move Chinese and preserve unknown complete actors
Bindings keep raw current amounts and do not reuse a prior observation
Same-rank substantive outputs and incomplete searches fail closed
Repeated slots are checked on a separate synthetic grammar, without shipping fabricated game sentences
Japanese local player length uses native five-character evidence; ordinary display nicknames keep their own bound
Every fixed Japanese tower greeting is source-bound and translated only as the complete current two-line unit
Offline common meanings never include the next clear page or localized parent-text expansion
All unresolved whole source records remain outside the published unit approval
TV literal pages use explicit dialogue context while all 170 pending variable pages stay unpublished
Frozen Chinese gate passes separately from unavailable live/negative/excluded Chinese evidence
Rebuild is byte-for-byte identical and the frozen original baseline remains 25/770

scope: S6 resource behavior, evidence identity, deterministic rebuild and offline handoff; no S7 Java/live or S8 whole-game acceptance
